title: Constructing and Exploring Intermediate Domains in Mixed Domain Semi-supervised Medical Image Segmentation (MiDSS)
mechanism: Labelled data from one domain, unlabelled from several: unified copy-paste between labelled and unlabelled images creates intermediate domains, plus training-progress-aware random amplitude mixup and symmetric guidance.
adaptation: Matches our pool shape (478 labelled full cells; unlabelled mono, multi, half-cells). Paste half-cell regions (cut line, scuffs) into labelled cells and labelled crack regions into half-cells; amplitude mixup from half-cells.
min_experiment: PF + UCP + TP-RAM (pool half-cells) vs PF + MT/CutMix (BRIEF s5 config), 3 seeds. Kill if E1 crack relF1@2 gain < +0.03.
evidence: R: +13.57% Dice on Prostate over SOTA, across Prostate, Fundus, M&Ms.
prior_overlap: Partial: MT + CutMix + external pool was n.d. at 100% labels; amplitude mixup and half-cell-targeted copy-paste are new.
